dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.falcation_vector: Concave trailing edge curve following a simple spline from ridge to apex.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.apex_bounding_geometry: Rounded apex with obtuse shape classification and medium pixel radius.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.leading_edge_angle: Shallow angular steepness relative to the primary dorsal axis.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.pixel_aspect_ratio: Approximately 1.5:1 base width to vertical height ratio.

anterior_cranial_contour.melon_arc_radius: Smooth convex arc with a large radius along the anterior-dorsal boundary.
anterior_cranial_contour.rostrum_aspect_vector: Short, broad rostrum protrusion with a low length-to-thickness ratio.
anterior_cranial_contour.cranial_inflection_angle: Obtuse interior angle transition between the melon slope and rostrum.

other_distinctive_markers: Monochromatic neon cyan luminescence and low-polygon geometric facets.
